chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, it is from the heat of Hell."

key_terms.إِنَّهَا: Indeed it; an emphatic reference to the thing being discussed
key_terms.جَهَنَّمَ: Hell; the fire of punishment in the afterlife
key_terms.فَيْحِ: Heat or scorching exhalation; intense emanating heat

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about extremely hot water?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام states that it is from the heat of Hell. In the chapter context on water, this indicates a ruling-related description of intensely hot water and frames it with imagery of Hell.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.25 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said: ""Indeed, it (hot water) is from the heat of Hell."
